remarks: Welcome to the Idyllic Retreat that you have been searching for! Located in S. Wilton, this home combines privacy, serenity, and a nature infused location with the close proximity to all that the area has to provide. Light splashed home with both a wood burning and gas fireplace. So many improvements made to the home. New kitchen appliances (20220, New HVAC system and heat pump (2023), New water heater (2023), guest bath updated (2021), Cedar plank wall in lower level (2024). This home is ready to move in! 3 spacious BR's on the main level. Lower level partially finished with a walk out slider leading to the backyard area. Can be used in a variety of useful ways. CENTRAL AIR throughout the home. Private serene setting. Come see for yourself and you will surely be taken by it all!
